svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Why Kikkar rewinds before it streams
svg.desc: Utho Kikkar ends, and the detector is sure 60 ms later. Said in one breath, the command has already begun by then. Sending from the trigger loses its start; Kikkar rewinds 320 ms into its 512 ms pre-roll and loses nothing.
svg.text: Kikkar: rewind 320 ms into the pre-roll, then stream live
